PSD correction via diagonal shift

Source: R/kernels.R
dot-psd_via_shift.Rd

Makes a symmetric sparse kernel PSD by adding (-lambda_min + eps) to the diagonal when its smallest eigenvalue lambda_min is negative. Keeps the matrix sparse; uses RSpectra for the extreme eigenvalue when available.

Usage

.psd_via_shift(K, eps = 1e-12)

Arguments

K

symmetric kernel matrix (coerced to sparse dgCMatrix).

eps

extra diagonal mass added on top of -lambda_min.

Value

A sparse symmetric PSD matrix.

Examples

## chain adjacency: indefinite (smallest eigenvalue is negative)
K <- Matrix::Matrix(abs(outer(1:4, 1:4, "-")) == 1, sparse = TRUE) * 1
Ks <- generalClusterExp:::.psd_via_shift(K)
min(eigen(as.matrix(Ks), symmetric = TRUE)$values) >= 0
#> [1] TRUE
